description: This file defines the ProjectController class which manages project-related operations such as viewing Gantt charts, generating project charts, creating, updating, deleting tasks, and managing resource charts within a CRM or project management system. It includes methods for handling AJAX requests, managing project tasks, retrieving predecessor options, and utility functions for date calculations.

classes.name: ProjectController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling project management and Gantt chart operations within the CRM system.

methods.name: action_view_GanttChart
methods.description: Loads the view for displaying the Gantt chart of a project.

methods.name: action_generate_chart
methods.description: Generates a Gantt chart for a project, including tasks and timeline visualization, and outputs related HTML/JavaScript.

methods.name: action_update_GanttChart
methods.description: Creates or updates a project task based on submitted form data, handling start/end dates and resource allocation.

methods.name: action_delete_task
methods.description: Marks a specific project task as deleted in the database.

methods.name: action_get_end_date
methods.description: Calculates and returns the end date of a task considering lag and business hours, used for AJAX.

methods.name: action_update_order
methods.description: Updates the order of project tasks based on a JSON array of task IDs and order numbers.

methods.name: action_get_predecessors
methods.description: Returns HTML options for selecting task predecessors in a project.

methods.name: create_task
methods.description: Creates a new project task with specified parameters and saves it to the database.

methods.name: update_task
methods.description: Updates an existing project task with new data.

methods.name: action_ResourceList
methods.description: Loads the resource list view for managing project resource allocations.

methods.name: action_update_chart
methods.description: Updates the resource chart based on selected projects, users, and date ranges.

methods.name: action_Tooltips
methods.description: Provides tooltip data for tasks associated with a specific resource within a date range.

methods.name: count_days
methods.description: Returns the total number of days between two dates, or -1 if the end date is before the start date.

methods.name: IsNullOrEmptyString
methods.description: Checks whether a string is null, unset, or only contains whitespace.
